{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute average revenue per channel within each segment
# This adjusts for the confounding by customer segment
stratified_revenue = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute the difference in average revenue per segment
revenue_diff_by_segment = stratified_revenue['email'] - stratified_revenue['paid_search']

# Print average revenue per channel within each segment
stratified_revenue, revenue_diff_by_segment"}
